hero.subtitle: Over two decades supplying OEM and aftermarket auto parts for Mercedes-Benz, BMW and MB Sprinter. Manufacturing in Asia, distribution in LATAM, North America and Europe.

intro.title: Every component leaves the warehouse with one promise: that your European vehicle runs like day one.
intro.body: We started in 2003 in Shanghai with a clear focus: replicate OEM tolerance in every part we produce. Today we operate a 12,800 m² logistics hub with lot-by-lot traceability, serving over 40 markets through authorized distributors like EMBLER in Mexico.

values.title: Four principles applied lot by lot.

items.title: OEM tolerance
items.desc: Every part is measured against the original drawing. There is no 'close enough' — it passes or it ships back.

items.title: Real traceability
items.desc: Serialized label per box. You can audit the lot from workshop back to production line.

items.title: Long-term partnership
items.desc: We work with distributors who know their markets. We don't sell to those who improvise.

items.title: Reliable availability
items.desc: OTIF 98.6% last 12 months. What we promise, ships on the date agreed.

plant.title: 24/6 operation with WMS connected to ERP.
plant.desc: 12,800 m² distributed across automated picking zones, climate control for sensitive components, and a dispatch port with RF scanner that validates every box before shipping. Three shifts with QC on each one.
